message.content: Oh, it’s not great—maybe once or twice a week, sometimes more if something goes wrong. We just have the one server, so when we update it or if it crashes, we’ve got to restart it. It’s usually only a few minutes of downtime, but it’s annoying when drones are flying and the data’s not there. The customers know it happens, so they don’t complain too much, but it’s still a pain.
